title: RESEARCH INTEGRITY AND GENAI: A SYSTEMATIC ANALYSIS OF ETHICAL CHALLENGES ACROSS RESEARCH PHASES

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through case tests of LLM-based translation tools, specifically observing the models' tendency to mix linguistic standards when processing text in similar low-resource languages (e.g., Bosnian, Croatian, and Serbian).
